drift_findings.description: POST /api/v1/auth/callback is implemented in auth.py and CSRF-exempted in main.py, but omitted from INTENTIONAL_PUBLIC_ROUTES in route_inventory.py, causing test_every_unauthenticated_route_has_an_explicit_public_reason to fail.

FastAPI warns on duplicate Operation IDs due to clinical_workbench being mounted at both /clinical-workbench and /clinical/workbench, and api_router being double-mounted with prefix='/api/v1' in main.py.
PhrProfile in db/models.py lacks 'version_no', but core/seed_admin_data.py passes version_no=5 during admin seed, triggering runtime warning 'Failed to seed admin clinical data'.
Design tokens exist in both contracts/design-tokens/tokens.json (v2026-08-19.v1) and packages/design-tokens/clara.tokens.json. Web and mobile code generators utilize packages/design-tokens/.
